facts.fact: Adam在车行一直找不到那辆车的故障点；这已是车主Mrs. Dickson第二次（the second time）把车送来修。
facts.anchor: He just couldn’t quite find it. This was the second time she’d brought it in.

facts.fact: Argent夸口她的车不用管美国街头合法性，能在under two seconds（不到两秒）内加速到sixty miles per hour（六十英里每小时）。
facts.anchor: “Do I care? It can hit sixty miles per hour in under two seconds.”

facts.fact: 剑之女王（Queen of Swords）Argent用glamour隐藏身份：把耳朵修圆、把肤色调成接近人类的色调。
facts.anchor: The Queen of Swords had hidden her nature with a glamour, rounding her ears and coloring her skin closer to human tones.

facts.fact: Argent开车载Adam去Night Market，要跟进Adam经由Dautre转达给她的信息。
facts.anchor: “The Night Market. I want to follow up on the information you passed through Dautre.

facts.fact: Argent打算对imps来一场bad cop, bad cop（双黑脸）审讯，她的笑容预示imps凶多吉少。
facts.anchor: “I was thinking something more along the lines of bad cop, bad cop.” Her smile did not bode well for the imps.

facts.fact: Argent转达Carl的问候，质问Adam是否非得打断Carl的鼻子——Carl为此相当恼火。
facts.anchor: “By the way, Carl sends his regards. Did you have to break his nose? He’s rather cross about it.”

facts.fact: Argent给Adam变出碳纤维（carbon fiber）护甲衣物，说自己早说过他需要护甲。
facts.anchor: “Carbon fiber,” she explained. “I told you that you needed armor. This will suffice for most things.”

facts.fact: Joey终于开口：他们无法供出买家的名字，因为另一个买家就是那个穿西装、已经死了的男人。
facts.anchor: “We cannot tell you his name because the other buyer was that guy in the suit, the one who died.”
